sources.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. ONE original Beaconline Writguard walking PASSING pose based on this exact standing identity. Keep bearded face/red-plumed helmet, blackened steel/brass armor, red scarf/tabard/cape, brown boots, tall standard in hand at screen LEFT with red banner and THREE lit brass lamps, kite shield STRAPPED to forearm at screen RIGHT with its lit inset lamp, same shield-arm HAND gripping the small poleaxe beneath shield, and belt lamp. Exactly two arms/hands, no gear swap. Change legs: STANDARD-SIDE leg at screen LEFT is the planted supporting leg below pelvis; SHIELD-SIDE leg at screen RIGHT raises its knee modestly forward, boot lifted visibly off ground. A restrained armored marching step, not a high kick. Upper torso stays same elevated three-quarter RIGHT-facing view; staff is carried slightly above ground, never shortened, and banner/cape flow backward. Full small poleaxe, complete standard finial and bottom tip, shield and both boots inside wide margins. Preserve original human body/weapon proportions, no mirror or duplicate weapon. Original detailed painterly tactical raster. Flat vivid GREEN #00ff00 background with green also through banner/arm/ring gaps, neutral illumination with no green spill. No ground, shadows, scenery, text or detached fragments; ignore tiny cut-off object at bottom of supplied reference.
sources.selection: Shield-side boot lifted, standard-side foot bears weight; all five lamps and attached standard/shield/axe retained.
